description:
About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

About the role

You will build and run Sales Development across Asia-Pacific. You will lead the APAC team and own its strategy: segmentation, org design and investment trade-offs, tied to the global revenue plan.

APAC is not one market. ANZ, India, Southeast Asia, Japan and Korea differ in language, buying norms, deal size and channel mix. Your job is to build one operating system that holds the standard across all of them and adapts where the market requires it.

What You'll Do

Set the APAC strategy and the plan to deliver it:

  • Write the APAC Sales Development strategy: segmentation by country and segment, org design, and where to invest first. Tie it to the global revenue plan and to peer regions.

  • Turn it into a plan the team can execute: capacity model, hiring sequence, resourcing, cross-functional dependencies and explicit trade-offs.

Build the team and the leadership bench:

  • Hire, onboard and develop SDRs for inbound qualification and outbound pipeline across APAC.

  • Spot future leaders early and develop them, so every key seat on the team has a successor.

  • Match reps to the countries and segments where they will perform best.

Design and run the operating system:

  • Decide which meetings, scorecards and inspection points exist, and why.

  • Adapt the system to each market without lowering the bar, and hold the team accountable to it.

  • Own leading indicators (activity, connect rate, meetings set, S0 to S1 conversion, pipeline created) and act on them quickly.

Run the economics:

  • Model capacity, coverage and cost per pipeline dollar by market and segment.

  • Build the business case for headcount and tooling (AI, sequencing, local-language data sources etc).

  • Spread investment across countries, teams and plays by expected return. Explain the choice to sales leadership.

Partner across functions and regions:

  • Co-own initiatives with RevOps, Enablement and Marketing, including turning APAC's free and open-source users into qualified pipeline.

  • Present results and recommendations to global sales leadership.

  • Work directly with APAC sales and marketing leaders and with peer regions to settle territories, shared global accounts, time-zone coverage and headcount trades, without needing someone to referee.

Carry the culture:

  • Set the culture standard and model it, so the behaviors show up in every rep's daily work.

  • Keep one standard across countries and segments, even where local context differs.

What We're Looking For

  • Based in Sydney and willing to be office-based 3 days per week

  • 8+ years in sales development, including 4+ years leading SDR teams; second-line experience (managing managers) is a strong plus

  • 3+ years leading sales development in APAC, across more than one country

  • Experience selling developer tools, DevOps or technical SaaS to engineering buyers

  • Experience building or scaling an outbound SDR function in a new region

  • Experience writing and implementing a regional plan with a capacity model and a headcount business case, and been measured against it

  • Hires and develops reps well, and can show people they've promoted

  • Uses data to decide: knows which metrics matter, what drives them and what a pipeline dollar costs

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building

  • Fluent in modern SDR tools: Salesforce, Nooks, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude

Nice to have

  • Experience with PLG motions that turn free users into pipeline

  • Familiarity with AI coding or code quality tools

  • Japanese, Korean or Mandarin, or experience running teams in those markets

  • Experience coordinating with HQ in another time zone (US Pacific)

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • An APAC strategy and capacity plan approved by sales leadership, with assumptions and known facts clearly separated

  • An operating system in place: weekly scorecard, inspection points and a meeting cadence for every market

  • First SDR hires made or in flight, with a hiring plan for the rest of the year

  • Territory and shared-account rules agreed with APAC sales and peer regions

First year

  • APAC SDR-sourced pipeline at or above plan, with cost per pipeline dollar known by market

  • At least one rep ready for promotion, and a clear bench of future leaders on the team

  • The same culture and standards visible with reps in every market

What We Offer

  1. Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

  2. Collaborative and innovative environment

  3. Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

  4. Professional development opportunities

     

Why Join CodeRabbit Now

  • A unique opportunity to build a category-defining company across the GenAI ecosystem

  • Tremendous product-led growth (PLG) motion and adoption, with lots of warm leads and opportunities to engage

  • Fast-growing team with strong career development and internal promotion opportunities

  • Ability to make a direct impact at an early-stage, high-growth company

     

Our Values

  1. Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence

  2. Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

  3. Persistent Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

  4. Impact-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

  5. Rapid Learners and Un-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world
